pull.title: KAFKA-20734: Return noNode for known partitions without endpoints
pull.body:
In `KRaftMetadataCache`, `getPartitionLeaderEndpoint` returns empty when the previous leader is offline after the refactor.

With this PR, the method now returns `noNode` when the leader partition exists, aligning with the original Scala implementation.

Changes are covered by unit tests. Please feel free to review.

Reviewers: Kevin Wu <kwu@confluent.io>, Justine Olshan
 <jolshan@confluent.io>

cherry-pick notes:
4.3 didn't yet convert some of the metadata files, so we don't have `MetadataCacheFixtures`. Because of this, I've updated the TransactionMarkerChannelManagerTest to not mock the specific metadata cache behavior. I've also updated KraftMetadataCacheTest.
